title: TapoBhumi
subtitle: Stories and meditations for a quiet mind

scenes.title: TapoBhumi
scenes.narration: Sit down for a moment. Not for long. Just long enough to hear a story... and then to hear the silence after it.

scenes.title: Just Watch
scenes.quote: The one who watches the mind is not the mind.
scenes.narration: Here we talk about awareness. Not thinking harder. Just watching. Watching the mind, the way you watch traffic from a window.

scenes.title: Empty Your Cup
scenes.quote: A full cup can receive nothing.
scenes.narration: We tell the old Zen stories. A professor comes to a master, full of opinions, and the master simply pours the tea... and keeps pouring.

scenes.title: The Way of Water
scenes.quote: Water does not fight, and nothing can stop it.
scenes.narration: The Taoist masters looked at water. It never fights. It goes around the rock. And in the end, the rock is gone, and the river is still singing.

scenes.title: Tales of the Heart
scenes.quote: The heart knows the road the head cannot see.
scenes.narration: The Sufis tell their truths as stories, so they slip past the mind and land straight in the heart.

scenes.title: Mulla Nasruddin
scenes.quote: He searched for the key where the light was better.
scenes.narration: And there is Mulla Nasruddin, the wise fool. You will laugh at him... and then, slowly, you will see that he is you.

scenes.title: Under the Tree
scenes.quote: There is no fire like passion; there is no happiness higher than rest.
scenes.narration: Twenty-five centuries ago a man sat under a tree and decided not to move until he understood. We tell his stories too.

scenes.title: Love Without Holding
scenes.quote: A bird in a golden cage is still in a cage.
scenes.narration: We talk about love. Not the love that holds and grabs and possesses. The love that opens the hand and lets the bird fly.

scenes.title: The Rope and the Snake
scenes.quote: Bring a lamp, and the snake was always a rope.
scenes.narration: We look at fear. Most of our fear is a rope in the dark that we have taken for a snake. All that is needed is a little light.

scenes.title: The Sound of the Bell
scenes.quote: Listen to the bell until it is only silence.
scenes.narration: We listen to silence. A temple bell rings... and fades... and in that fading, something in you becomes very still.

scenes.title: Only This Moment
scenes.quote: Yesterday is a memory. Tomorrow is a dream. This breath is real.
scenes.narration: Again and again we come back to this moment. Not yesterday, not tomorrow. This breath. This one.

scenes.title: The Drop and the Ocean
scenes.quote: The drop does not die in the ocean. It becomes the ocean.
scenes.narration: And we celebrate. Life is not a problem to be solved. It is a song to be sung, a dance to be danced.

scenes.title: Close Your Eyes
scenes.narration: Every long talk here ends the same way. We close our eyes together, and we do nothing at all. Come. Sit with us.
